readExpColumn - Define expression comparisons for levi

Source: R/readExpColumn.R
readExpColumn.Rd

Specify which columns of the expression file represent the test condition and the control condition for the landscape computation. Multiple comparisons can be provided in a single call to enable batch-mode processing (one landscape per comparison).

readExpColumn(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Character string of the form "TestColumn-ControlColumn", where TestColumn and ControlColumn are column names in the expression file. The hyphen (-) separates test from control. Special cases:

  • Single-column logFC input (e.g., DESeq2 log2FoldChange only): repeat the same column name on both sides - "log2FoldChange-log2FoldChange".

  • Self-comparison (null landscape): use the same column twice - "Sample-Sample".

...

Additional comparisons, each following the same "Test-Control" format. When multiple comparisons are supplied, levi() generates one landscape per comparison and returns a list.

Value

A named list used internally by levi to identify the expression columns for each comparison. The first element is always the function call itself (used as a sentinel); subsequent elements are the comparison strings.

Details

Column names must match exactly the column headers in the expression file or data.frame (case-sensitive). The hyphen separator is required; column names that themselves contain hyphens should be renamed before use.

When using signal_mode = "logfc" with a single-column fold-change input (e.g., from leviFromDESeq2), repeat the logFC column name: readExpColumn("log2FoldChange-log2FoldChange"). The function detects baseTest == baseControl and routes to single-column mode automatically.

See also

levi, leviFromDESeq2, leviFromEdgeR, leviFromLimma, leviFromSeurat

Author

Jose Rafael Pilan rafael.pilan@unesp.br

Examples

# Single comparison
readExpColumn("TumorCurrentSmoker-NormalNeverSmoker")
#> [[1]]
#> readExpColumn
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "TumorCurrentSmoker-NormalNeverSmoker"
#> 

# Multiple comparisons (batch mode) - levi() returns a list
readExpColumn(
    "TumorCurrentSmoker-NormalNeverSmoker",
    "TumorFormerSmoker-NormalFormerSmoker"
)
#> [[1]]
#> readExpColumn
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "TumorCurrentSmoker-NormalNeverSmoker"
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] "TumorFormerSmoker-NormalFormerSmoker"
#> 

# Single-column logFC (repeat the column name)
readExpColumn("log2FoldChange-log2FoldChange")
#> [[1]]
#> readExpColumn
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "log2FoldChange-log2FoldChange"
#> 

# Self-comparison (null landscape, all scores ~ 0.5)
readExpColumn("Sample1-Sample1")
#> [[1]]
#> readExpColumn
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "Sample1-Sample1"
#>
